title: Artificially Fluent: Swahili AI Performance Benchmarks Between English-Trained and Natively-Trained Datasets

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing text classification error rates and accuracy between a natively trained monolingual Swahili model (SwahBERT) tested on Swahili news data and a monolingual English model (BERT) tested on the same Swahili data auto-translated into English.
